events.name: The Crowd Swells
events.description: The ballroom seems to grow smaller as the crowd thickens around the dance floor.  Whispers of conversation are easily caught.
events.result: The "Read the room" action automatically succeeds this round.

events.name: An Unfortunate Joke
events.description: A humorous quip gets misinterpreted, and suspicion briefly sets in.
events.result: All characters must succeed a charm test when "Probing secrets" or "Telling tales" this round, or gain a chatter token.

events.name: Scenario special event
events.description: An unexpected occurance... can you make of it an opportunity?
events.result: Effects depend on the scenario. Follow the instructions provided in the scenario's special rules section.
